meaningWithJp.meaning: person way of doing -- honorific form for 人 (ひと) --; way of doing
why why (same as どうして)
half half (e.g., にじはん | half-past two)
(humble) to do -- extra-modest expression for する --
(respectful) to be to come or to go -- honorific expression for いく, くる, and いる --
(polite) your house (someone else's) house; home -- polite word for 家 (いえ) --
(respectful) to say -- honorific expression for いう --
(polite) to give -- humble expression for あげる --
generally approximately; in most cases; in general; to begin with (same as もともと)
to ask to inquire (same as 質問する)
